Name: New Shelf Designs and Colors
Author: BethKitten
Description:
[size=4][font=Georgia]Welcome to my new Wooden Shelves Recolor mod.  

This is a total rehaul of my other mod for Wooden Shelves.  Besides new colors to pick from, 13 different colors, you now get new designs.  The single shelf is just recolors but the two and three shelves now have 4 different modern designs to pick from.
[/font][/size]
[font=Georgia][size=4]Pictures of user's in game are welcome.  If you have any issues at all, please let me know AND include your [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url].
[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4]You will need to have all the required files installed with any dependencies they call for, before using this mod!  Also remember that you can obtain the shelves either from Robin or through the DGA store.
[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=4]A very special Thank you to the following members for testing this mod for me:
[/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/85287593]sexynes[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/58746061]PurpleChickadee[/url]
[/size][size=4]ModLearner217309

Without you guys helping out, this mod would not have happened now, but still be in development.
[/size][/font]
[font=Georgia][size=4]Updates will be made as needed or for new contain.  This is an Alternative Texture pack only.

Please do not ask about making this into another type of mod as that is not possible at this time.


I only upload my mods on Nexus.  If found anywhere else do not download it as it has  been stolen.  Instead report it to me [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/117914948]directly[/url]﻿.  Unless given permission to do so, no one is to use any assets found in this mod (be it for editing or Recolor).

To see my other mods please [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/117914948?tab=user+files]click here[/url]﻿.
[/size][/font]
